name: cell-environment-coupling-spatial
title: Cell–Environment Coupling, Spatial (flagship)
question:
When a single cell metabolizes at its own location, does it measurably reshape the very
nutrient gradient it depends on — niche construction (odling1996) — closing the paper's
§Cell–environment coupling sense → metabolize → secrete loop (Fig 5) as real spatial
metabolism: one cell sensing local glucose, running flux-balance analysis at its own footprint,
growing, and secreting a byproduct that diffuses back into the field it senses? The paper
frames this feedback loop as "the minimal structure required for control"; here the loop is
genuinely closed (a real depletion → uptake feedback), while directed control — chemotaxis up
the sensed gradient — is the deferred half. Mechanistically, the cell and its environment are
two real, independently-built simulators (viva-cpm's Cellular Potts engine, spatio-flux's
diffusion-advection and dynamic-FBA processes) composed through one typed coupling process
(`CpmCellField`), rather than a scripted or lumped stand-in for that coupling.
biological_summary:
A cell does not merely inhabit its environment — it remakes it. Here one
cell sits in a nutrient gradient, eats at its own location, and secretes a byproduct back into
the field, measurably reshaping the very gradient it depends on: niche construction (odling1996),
realized spatially. This is the paper's §Cell–environment coupling sense → metabolize → secrete
loop (Fig 5), and this investigation's flagship. The paper frames this feedback loop as "the
minimal structure required for control": here the loop is genuinely closed (a real
depletion → uptake feedback), while directed control — chemotaxis up the sensed gradient — is a
tracked, deferred half (see key_assumptions/limitations), so this cell senses, metabolizes,
grows, and secretes, but does not yet act on what it senses. Mechanically it composes two real,
independently-built simulators through one typed coupling process (`CpmCellField`): one CPM cell
— a real Cellular Potts Model agent from viva-cpm, with genuine pixel-level shape, adhesion, and
volume dynamics on a 60x60 lattice — with a shared spatio-flux `fields` grid (glucose, acetate)
running `DiffusionAdvection`. `CpmCellField` is the entire interface between
them: each tick it reads the mean glucose concentration at the cell's current footprint (the
set of lattice pixels the CPM cell occupies), solves one dynamic-FBA step against `e_coli_core`
with Michaelis–Menten-limited glucose uptake (`glucose_km`, `glucose_vmax`) and a fixed
oxygen cap (`oxygen_vmax`) — the O2 cap is what forces the optimizer into mixed-acid acetate
overflow rather than pure aerobic respiration, matching the biological mechanism this coupling
is meant to demonstrate. That causal claim is not left to the code: the O2-uncapped mechanism
control (`o2-cap-forces-acetate-overflow` below) lifts the oxygen bound and shows acetate
secretion collapses to ~0 while the capped flagship secretes a real plume, so the overflow is a
demonstrated experiment rather than an assertion. The coupling then mass-balances the FBA
solution against how much glucose the
footprint actually holds (so the cell can never manufacture biomass or acetate from glucose it
did not actually remove), grows the CPM cell's target volume in proportion to the resulting
biomass, and writes the clamped glucose uptake and acetate secretion back into the field as a
spatial delta. spatio-flux's own `DiffusionAdvection` then spreads both species outward: the
depleted local glucose is partially resupplied from the field's pre-set left-low-to-right-high
gradient, and the secreted acetate forms an expanding plume.

Measured on `single-cell-in-a-field` over 20 ticks (`tests/test_flagship_field.py`,
`tests/test_cpm_cell_field.py`, `tests/test_cpm_viz.py`): the CPM cell grows from 32 to 110
lattice pixels (about 3.4x), against a 60x60 = 3600-pixel lattice — roughly 3% coverage at the
end, nowhere near filling the field. Local footprint glucose peaks at 1.15 (t=2, after diffusion
briefly outpaces the cell's own uptake) then falls to 0.94 by t=20, an up-to-~18% local
drawdown as the cell's own consumption outpaces the partial resupply diffusion provides. Field-wide,
net glucose falls by about 32 units (5940 -> 5908, out of the field's full 3600-pixel total
mass) — a small fraction of the whole field, because only the cell's own footprint and its
immediate diffusive neighborhood are touched, which is exactly the local, footprint-scale niche
construction the composite is built to show rather than a field-wide depletion event. Acetate,
starting at zero everywhere, rises to a field-wide total of about 47 by t=20 as the secreted
byproduct diffuses into a spreading plume. Biomass (the FBA-tracked internal state driving CPM
growth) rises from 0.1 to about 0.37.
claim:
Composing a real CPM cell with a real spatio-flux nutrient field through one typed
coupling process (`CpmCellField`) reproduces the paper's §Cell–environment coupling
sense → metabolize → secrete loop (Fig 5) as genuine spatial metabolism, not a scripted stand-in
for it (the loop is closed; directed control/chemotaxis is deferred): over 20 ticks the
cell runs dynamic-FBA at its own
footprint (`e_coli_core`, O2-capped to force acetate overflow), grows ~3.4x in CPM volume (32
-> 110 px, ~3% of a 60x60 lattice it does not come close to filling), depletes local glucose by
up to ~18% before diffusion partially resupplies it (niche construction), and secretes a
diffusing acetate plume — two independently-built simulators talking through one typed port.
key_assumptions:
e_coli_core constants (`glucose_km` 0.5, `glucose_vmax` 3.5, `oxygen_vmax` 2.5,
`box_volume_L` 0.3, `grow_per_biomass` 300.0) are toy-real: plausible, hand-tuned magnitudes
chosen to produce gradual, spatially-legible dynamics over a short (~20-25 tick) run, not
fitted to a named organism, medium, or literature target.

The metabolized/diffused nutrient field is exclusively the spatio-flux `fields` store
(glucose, acetate) that `CpmCellField` and `DiffusionAdvection` share. The CPM cell's OWN
internal lattice/world (its shape, occupied pixels, footprint) lives inside viva-cpm's Rust
engine as a private object the coupling process owns (`CpmCellField.world`) — it is not a
process-bigraph store, and no other process in the composite reads or writes it. viva-cpm's
own internal field concept (`field_at_cell`, `secretory_types`, `receptor_coupling`) is
separate machinery this composite does not use.

Growth is roughly exponential in this coupling (biomass compounds each tick), so the run is deliberately bounded to ~20-25 ticks — a longer run would need either a saturating growth term or a much larger field to stay spatially legible rather than filling the lattice.

Chemotaxis toward the sensed field (directed up-gradient motion) is deferred to a follow-up variant; the flagship cell senses, metabolizes, grows, and secretes, but does not chemotax — its modest position drift over the run (roughly (17,17) seed to about (18.7, 30.3) by t=20) is CPM thermal fluctuation under the configured temperature, not directed motion.

behavior_tests.name: o2-cap-forces-acetate-overflow
behavior_tests.description: Foundational mechanism control (not this study's scientific claim): the acetate the flagship secretes is CAUSED BY the O2 cap, not an artifact of the coupling. This runs a second composite (`single-cell-in-a-field-o2uncapped`) identical to the flagship except the oxygen bound is lifted (`oxygen_vmax` 2.5 -> 1000, EX_o2_e effectively unbounded). With respiration no longer capacity-limited, unconstrained e_coli_core takes pure aerobic respiration as growth-optimal and EX_ac_e sits at 0 — so the cell secretes ~0 acetate (and grows faster: biomass ~2.35 vs the capped ~0.37), while the capped flagship secretes a real plume. This turns the study's overflow claim ("the O2 cap is what forces the optimizer into mixed-acid overflow") from a code assertion into a demonstrated experiment. The flagship was built first and, unlike the later studies, had no such foundational control until this pass; this is it.

measure.expr: sum(fields.acetate) with oxygen uncapped vs capped

pass_if.provenance: field-wide acetate over 20 ticks: capped flagship 0 -> ~47.0, O2-uncapped 0 -> 0.0 (exactly), a >100x collapse; uncapped biomass ~2.35 vs capped ~0.37 (the cell respires fully instead of overflowing) (tests/test_flagship_field.py::test_o2_cap_is_what_forces_acetate_overflow; composite meta_modelers_guide/composites/single-cell-in-a-field-o2uncapped.composite.json)

behavior_tests.name: field-mass-balance-closes
behavior_tests.description: Foundational conservation control (not this study's scientific claim): the paper frames conservation laws (mass, energy balance) as interface constraints on any coupling. This runs the flagship composite through a closed per-species ledger — for glucose and acetate, initial_field_mass + Σ(every writer's own reported net exchange) == final_field_mass — where the writer's reported delta and what actually accumulates in the shared grid travel through two independent code paths (the process's per-tick arithmetic vs process-bigraph's additive `apply` for a `map[array]` port), so a clamp that manufactures mass, a double-write, or a schema `apply` that concatenates instead of sums surfaces as a nonzero residual. The ledger also shows the cell nets a glucose sink and an acetate source while DiffusionAdvection under Neumann BC nets ~0.

pass_if.provenance: both glucose and acetate ledgers close to < 1e-6 over 15 ticks; cell net glucose < 0 (sink) and net acetate > 0 (source), diff net ~0 for both (tests/test_mass_balance.py::test_flagship_field_mass_balance_closes; meta_modelers_guide/analysis/mass_balance.py)

findings.statement:
A real CPM cell coupled to a real spatio-flux nutrient field through one typed
process (`CpmCellField`) closes the paper's §Cell–environment coupling
sense → metabolize → secrete loop (Fig 5) as genuine spatial metabolism (the loop is closed;
directed control/chemotaxis is deferred): it
runs dynamic-FBA at its own footprint and grows both biologically (biomass) and structurally
(CPM lattice volume). Confirmed: biomass 0.1 -> ~0.37, CPM volume 32 -> 110 px (~3.4x) over
20 ticks, on a 3600-pixel lattice the cell occupies only ~3% of by the end.

The cell measurably depletes the local nutrient it senses before diffusion partially
resupplies it — niche construction as a direct spatial-metabolic consequence, not a scripted
trajectory. Confirmed: local footprint glucose concentration peaks at 1.15 (t=2) and falls to
0.94 by t=20, an up-to-~18% local drawdown, while the field-wide glucose total falls by only
~32 of 5940 units — the depletion signature is sharply local to the cell's own footprint and
its immediate diffusive neighborhood, not a field-wide event.

The O2-capped dynamic-FBA mechanism forces the optimizer into mixed-acid acetate
overflow (rather than pure aerobic respiration), and that byproduct genuinely diffuses
outward into a spreading plume via spatio-flux's own `DiffusionAdvection` process — the
secretion side of the coupling is as real as the uptake side. Confirmed: field-wide acetate
0 -> ~47.0 over 20 ticks.

The acetate overflow is CAUSED BY the O2 cap, shown by experiment rather than
asserted from code: lifting the oxygen bound (O2-uncapped control, oxygen_vmax 2.5 -> 1000)
collapses acetate secretion to ~0 while the capped flagship secretes a real plume — the cell
respires fully instead of overflowing (and grows faster for it). Confirmed: field-wide acetate
capped 0 -> ~47.0 vs uncapped 0 -> 0.0 (exactly); uncapped biomass ~2.35 vs capped ~0.37.

evidence.observed: acetate capped ~47.0 vs uncapped 0.0; biomass uncapped ~2.35 vs capped ~0.37

regression_compatibility.basis: single-cell-in-a-field.composite.json (and its O2-uncapped control sibling single-cell-in-a-field-o2uncapped.composite.json) build and run to completion through the process-bigraph engine (tests/test_flagship_field.py, tests/test_cpm_cell_field.py, tests/test_cpm_viz.py, tests/test_mass_balance.py, tests/test_composites_build.py); guarded skip when the optional cobra dependency is absent, matching draft-to-living-cell's FBA-grain convention.

biological_validation.basis: All four primary behavior tests pass on measured readouts from a real 20-tick run — the cell metabolizes and grows (biomass, CPM volume), depletes its own local nutrient before diffusion resupplies it (niche construction), and secretes a diffusing acetate plume — and the two foundational controls hold. The O2-uncapped control demonstrates the overflow is caused by the O2 cap (uncapped acetate ~0), and the closed field mass-balance ledger closes to < 1e-6 for glucose and acetate.

explanatory_gain.basis: Composing a real Cellular Potts cell with a real spatial dFBA+diffusion simulator through one typed process makes the paper's cell-environment coupling claim concrete at a level of mechanistic resolution draft-to-living-cell's lumped 9-cell grid could not reach — genuine cell shape, genuine flux-balance optimization, genuine PDE diffusion, all talking through one interface neither framework was built with the other in mind for.

conclusion:
## Claims
- A single cell reshapes the very nutrient gradient it depends on — niche construction
(odling1996), realized spatially. Composing a real CPM cell with a real spatio-flux nutrient
field through one typed coupling process (`CpmCellField`) reproduces the paper's
§Cell–environment coupling sense → metabolize → secrete loop (Fig 5) as genuine spatial
metabolism — the loop closed (depletion → uptake feedback), with directed control (chemotaxis)
the deferred half.
Over 20 ticks the cell grows ~3.4x in CPM volume (32 -> 110 px, ~3% of a 60x60 lattice it does
not come close to filling), depletes its own local glucose by up to ~18% before diffusion
partially resupplies it (niche construction), and secretes a diffusing acetate plume from an
O2-capped dynamic-FBA overflow mechanism.

## Evidence
- **CELL-METABOLIZES-AND-GROWS** — biomass 0.1 -> ~0.37 via dynamic-FBA at the cell's own
footprint
- **CPM-VOLUME-GROWS** — CPM lattice volume 32 -> 110 px (~3.4x), ~3% lattice coverage
- **ACETATE-SECRETED-AND-DIFFUSES** — field-wide acetate 0 -> ~47.0 as the plume spreads
- **NET-GLUCOSE-CONSUMED** — field-wide glucose 5940.0 -> ~5908.4; local footprint drawdown up
to ~18%
- **O2-CAP-FORCES-ACETATE-OVERFLOW** (foundational control) — O2-uncapped acetate 0 -> 0.0
(exactly) vs capped 0 -> ~47.0: the overflow is caused by the O2 cap, shown by experiment
- **FIELD-MASS-BALANCE-CLOSES** (foundational control) — glucose and acetate ledgers close to
< 1e-6 (cell nets a glucose sink + acetate source; diffusion nets ~0)

## Limitations
- e_coli_core constants (`glucose_km`, `glucose_vmax`, `oxygen_vmax`, `box_volume_L`,
`grow_per_biomass`) are toy-real — plausible, hand-tuned magnitudes, not fitted to any
organism or medium.
- Chemotaxis toward the sensed field is deferred to a follow-up variant; the cell does not move
directionally up-gradient in this composite. Its modest position drift is CPM thermal
fluctuation, not directed motion.
- Growth is roughly exponential in this coupling, so the run is deliberately bounded to
~20-25 ticks to stay spatially legible; a longer run was not attempted.
- The metabolized field is exclusively the spatio-flux `fields` store; the CPM cell's own
internal lattice/world is a private, write-protected object inside viva-cpm's Rust engine,
not a process-bigraph store, and no other process reads or writes it.
## Next steps
- Add directed chemotaxis (motion up the sensed gradient) as a variant of this composite.
- Fan out to the next spatial counterpart, multi-cell competition over one shared field
(`cell-cell-coupling`'s spatial analogue), reusing `CpmCellField` for each competing cell.

visualizations.name: single-cell-in-a-field-movie
visualizations.description:
Animated GIF of the 20-tick flagship run, three synced panels sharing the same
footprint outline and center-of-mass marker: (left) the glucose field as a heatmap with the
CPM cell's footprint outlined in white and its center of mass marked, the field's
left-low-to-right-high gradient visible as the underlying color ramp; (middle) glucose
depletion (Δ from t=0) on a diverging blue/red scale centered at zero — blue where the cell

forming around the cell's footprint), red where diffusion has net-resupplied a cell; (right)
the acetate field as a heatmap, starting at zero everywhere and showing the secreted plume
spreading outward from the cell's footprint as the run progresses. Re-baked directly via

cadence-1 run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.
